doosearch.catchy_phrase: A customizable homepage for your web browser

customization.title: A page that reflects you
customization.description: Let your personality shine. Say goodbye to your browser's dull, austere background. Make way for vivid, sparkling, or even pastel colors. And why not set a wallpaper? I bet you'll choose an original and unique background.

everywhere.title: Everywhere with you
everywhere.description: Are you a keyboard/mouse or smartphone/tablet person? Doosearch is perfectly adapted for use on PC, tablet, and smartphone, because it was designed for it. A single URL address is enough for all your devices.

how_it_works.title: How does it work?
how_it_works.description: You enter your query and Doosearch takes care of transmitting it to your target website. You will just need to define your target search engines (the websites you wish to query), among the hundred proposed, and Doosearch will take care of transmitting them.
how_it_works.info: Information: Our servers do not retain any info concerning your searches.

multi_search.title: Simultaneous search
multi_search.description: Did you know that you can easily launch a search on several websites simultaneously? Promised, you won't have any copy-pasting to do, it's quite simple actually. You have to select the target search engines just before executing your query. To choose several, you must right-click on the engine's logo and then click on "Add this engine".

search_engines.title: More than 100 search engines
search_engines.description: You're dizzy, right? There's something for everyone. There are specialized engines for high-tech, online shopping, and even cooking. You can also try to find a family member on the various social networks you know.

list.search_engines: A selection of more than 100 search engines*
list.multi_search: Execute a query on several websites simultaneously
list.cross_platform: Usable from your PC, tablet, and smartphone

definition.main: Doosearch is a web page offering you the possibility to launch a search to more than 100 different search engines* (including Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, and Qwant).
definition.asterisk: * A search engine is a tool made available by a website to find information on the internet more quickly. It then presents the obtained results based on the keywords entered.
